name: Kalpataru Avana
address: Off Dr. S.S. Rao Road / Dr. Walimbe Road, behind ITC Grand Central, Parel, Mumbai 400012
amenities: Indoor swimming pool and kids' pool
description: A single high-rise luxury residential building (North and South wings) by Kalpataru behind ITC Grand Central in Parel, with 3 BHK, 4 BHK and 5 BHK duplex homes. The developer highlights east-west orientation, 12'10" floor-to-floor height and wide sundecks facing the eastern seaboard. Kalpataru lists it as completed with full Occupation Certificate received.
notes: MahaRERA P51900000793 (RERA completion date 30 Dec 2022). Kalpataru's site says 'Full OC received', but no OC date was found. Listing sites say possession began around Sep-Dec 2022 and that the OC appears in Kalpataru's FY2022-23 annual report (not independently verified). Launch: Housing.com says May 2014 and Square Yards says April 2014. Older listings quoted possession of Dec 2020 or Dec 2021, which points to a delay of roughly 2 years against early marketing dates, though no news coverage of the delay was found. Floors conflict across listings (44, 50, 52, 'up to 57'; one says 2 basements + 6 podium + 40 habitable floors per tower), so floors_max of 57 is from a single aggregator citing MahaRERA. Units are 276 per RERA-derived data (Square Yards: 254 booked as of Nov 2025; another listing says 272). Land area also conflicts (2.3 / 2.4 / 0.33 acres), so it is omitted. No independent news coverage (launch, deals, litigation) was found for this project. Enrichment (Nov 2026), from Kalpataru Ltd's IPO red herring prospectus (RHP, June 2025): Avana is two residential towers of 41 floors each, on 2.30 acres, with 0.58 million sq ft of saleable area; the first habitable floor is 90 ft above ground; it has only two apartments per floor and IGBC Green Homes Platinum certification; it completed in 2022 against a RERA date of 30 Dec 2022; and 86.01% of saleable area (0.50 msf) was sold before the OC. CHANGED: towers from 1 to 2 (RHP says two residential towers; the developer site calls them North and South wings), floors_max from 57 to 52 (CTBUH lists 52 floors above ground and 201 m, completed 2022; the RHP's 41 floors appear to be habitable floors above the podium), and land_acres set to 2.30 per the RHP (resolving the earlier 2.3 / 2.4 / 0.33 conflict). The RHP's 'saleable area' is carpet plus loading for common areas, services, parking and amenities, so its average realisations (Rs 25,735 to 33,057/sq ft) sit well below carpet-basis registered and asking rates. Litigation: the RHP discloses 10 appeals by Avana buyers pending before real-estate authorities, claiming interest and compensation for delayed possession, which Kalpataru contests; rera_complaints records these 10. Units: Square Yards' RERA-based breakdown (Nov 2025) is 48 3 BHK, 82 4 BHK, 4 5 BHK, 8 duplexes and 134 'studio' units (10 type 1, 124 type 2), 276 in all with 254 booked; two flats per floor across 2 x 41 floors would give only 164 large apartments (computed), so the studios may be ancillary units, and unit_types counts exclude them. The 12 under '5 BHK / duplex' are 4 5 BHK plus 8 duplexes. OC date is still not found. Views: 'sea' refers to the developer's sundecks facing open green spaces and the eastern seaboard (harbour side), not the western sea face.nearest_metro is a monorail station, straight-line distance per Mumbai Property Exchange; Currey Road rail station is about 1.2 km. Mumbai Property Exchange's MahaRERA extract names Atul Gulati as architect (unverified, so architect is left out). Liquidity conflicts: PropertyButler counts 9 registered sales and 6 leases in 12 months, Square Yards only 2 sales, so transactions_12m is left out. No launch-era (2014) price was found; the earliest sourced figures are the Sep 2020 registered deed and the RHP's FY2022 average.

news.title: Kalpataru Limited red herring prospectus discloses 10 pending RERA appeals by Avana buyers
news.summary: Kalpataru's IPO prospectus lists 10 appeals by Kalpataru Avana buyers pending before real-estate authorities, seeking interest and compensation for alleged delays in possession; the company denies any delay. It also reports FY2022 to Dec 2024 average realisations of Rs 25,735 to 33,057/sq ft of saleable area.
